items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I'm speaking about when they were playing with Tommy Fox at the Ritz-Carlton Room

ctx.x: Yeh, but I'm speaking about when they were playing with Tommy Fox at the Ritz-Carlton Room - they had a brass section, I mean, forget it! Because nobody had a brass section like that but McKinney Cotton Pickers with Carl Neshitt and what have you, I mean...
Just to keep the record straight so we can
